description: Turns two voltages into whole numbers, does arithmetic on them and puts the answers back out as voltages

inputs.text: The first number, N, taken from 0-10V as a whole number of 23 bits
The second number, M, taken the same way

outputs.text: N divided by M, with the remainder thrown away; at M of zero it carries 0V
N times M, with anything above 23 bits wrapped round
The remainder of N divided by M; at M of zero it carries 0V
N plus M, with anything above 23 bits wrapped round
N minus M, wrapped round when it goes below zero, despite the panel printing M−N

notes: the wrapping is what makes this a sound source rather than a calculator: an audio signal at N comes out folded into hard-edged steps

inputs.0:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
